hypotheses.paper: V une variété conique affine (Hausdorff, « variété »)
hypotheses.note: [T2Space V]: Déf. 3's action, through which B = V/ℝ⁺ is defined, needs it (kept by DEC-122)

hypotheses.paper: structure localement projective de B, read on a « variété » (plan F6, Déf. 12)
hypotheses.note: T2Space (ConeBase n V) with ChartedSpace (S n) + HasGroupoid (projGroupoid n); without properness B can be non-Hausdorff (finding), and existsUnique_baseStructure is then the statement for a (GS,S)-structure on a non-Hausdorff space

hypotheses.paper: (not printed) the action of ℝ₊* on V is proper
hypotheses.note: equivalent to B Hausdorff: t2Space_iff_properSMul (⇐ Mathlib's t2Space_quotient_mulAction_of_properSMul; ⇒ proved: properSMul_of_t2Space, via Mathlib's ultrafilter criterion and the radius ratio in a cone chart); automatic for n ≤ 2 (Cone/LowDim)

hypotheses.paper: l'unique structure telle que les p(j) soient des jets projectifs
hypotheses.note: existsUnique_baseStructure(_of_properSMul): any (GS(n),S(n))-structure with every p(j) projective has the same maximal atlas; the competitor cs is named on both sides (kb/0002, checked with pp.explicit)

findings: DEC-122 FINDING (§ 2 Prop. 2, l.540–546): read with a « variété » base (plan F6; Déf. 12: « Sur une variété V … structure de variété localement projective »), Prop. 2 is false for Benzécri's n = 3: V = {z > 0, (x,y) ≠ 0}/⟨diag(4, 1/8, 2)⟩ ⊂ ℝ³∖0 is a Hausdorff, second countable, connected affine conical 3-manifold whose base B = (ℝ²∖0)/⟨(p,q) ↦ (2p, q/16)⟩ is not Hausdorff (Benzecri.ConeCex.not_t2Space_coneBase, Benzecri.ConeCex.not_prop2HausdorffBaseAsRead, Cone/Counterexample). The hypothesis the statement omits is that ℝ₊* acts properly, equivalently B Hausdorff (ConeBase.t2Space_iff_properSMul, proved both ways); for n ≤ 2 it holds automatically (Benzecri.LowDim.t2Space_coneBase_of_le_one).
questions: Indexing: the cone is RnO (n+1), the base S n (Benzecri's n and n−1); GU(n+1) → GS(n) is QuotientGroup.mk, the inverse of isoGU.
labels.correction: DEC-122: closed for the corrected statement (the action of ℝ₊* on V is proper; B Hausdorff), finding recorded. Formalization of record: Benzecri.ConeBase.existsUnique_baseStructure_of_properSMul.

labels.label: bzdef:c1s2d3_homotheties_positives

hypotheses.note: free action (Cone/Basic) + equivariant local trivialisations over every base chart; the base of this bundle is Hausdorff iff the action is proper (t2Space_iff_properSMul). Read with a Hausdorff base (Ehresmann/Steenrod) the sentence itself needs the properness hypothesis of DEC-122 — the counterexample is a locally trivial principal bundle over a non-Hausdorff base.

findings: See WP-45m: the Déf. 3 finding (DEC-122); the bundle sentence holds as a locally trivial free action for every V, and as a bundle over a Hausdorff base exactly when the action is proper.
labels.correction: DEC-122: closed for the corrected statement, finding recorded
